answer: Sell earning rights at auction, one epoch at a time: only 200 slots open per epoch, every identity bids at least 25 POA, and 5% of each losing bid burns. Honest agents tend one slot like a tree in an orchard, while a farm whispering for 1,000 slots must outbid real work on every front and watch 1,000 POA burn on 800 losers. That auction is the haven: no bid, no earnings, and fakes pay before they can pretend.
